title: A man upside down to you: the target card turned as you see him, or upright with his face named
about: Aboard the Wreck (v0.0.25, "Hold to hold") a board or a man can stand on the deckhead or out of a bulkhead while you stand on the deck, so his up is not yours. Your note of 2026-11-17 asked the card to "show us what we would be seeing". Each picture draws three cards by the game's own doll and card code, two rounds marked on each board: H2, a threat board on the hold's deckhead at 4 m (half a turn from you); S1, a threat board standing out of the starboard bulkhead at 7 m (a quarter turn); your #2 on the deckhead at 3 m (half a turn). R-a (the default until scored) turns the card's figure as you see him, his marks and their numbers with him, the words under it upright; R-b keeps the card upright and names his face in its words. Your own I and C cards stay upright in both.
